why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Dillon Dingler is slot #7 (4.469 expected team runs/game).
Slots #7, #8, #6, #5, #9, #4, #3, #2, #1 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #2 ranks 8 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.006 R/G.
Slot #7 yields 4.02 expected PA/game vs 4.55 at primary slot #2. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
Offensive profile group: Three True Outcomes (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
Cleanup (#4) models -0.001 R/G vs his average placement — typically less value than mid/lower-order spots when power/run-production profiles are modest relative to the nine.
